transcript:
Speaker A (Voiceover): एक डॉन की बेटी, एक इंग्लिश टीचर, एक क्लासरूम जहां ग्रामर नहीं प्यार पढ़ाया जाता था। हर लेसन एक इशारा था। लेकिन इस प्यार के पीछे एक ऐसा झूठ छुपा था जो अगर खुल जाता तो दोनों की जान चली जाती। [A don't daughter, an English teacher, a classroom where love was taught instead of grammar. Every lesson was a hint. But behind this love lay a lie that, if revealed, would cost both their lives.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): अरे वाह! आज सूरज कहां से उग गया? तुम यहां मुझसे पहले आ गई? [Oh wow! Where did the sun rise from today? You got here before me?]
Speaker C (Ayesha): मेरा मन हुआ तो आ गई। [I felt like coming, so I came.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): गुड। तो आज हम कुछ नया सीखेंगे। [Good. So today we will learn something new.]
Speaker C (Ayesha - thinking): तो तुम्हारे दिल में मेरे लिए क्या है? हिम्मत या प्यार? [So what is in your heart for me? Courage or love?]
Speaker D (Woman - thinking): यही मौका है शेखर। आयशा को अपने प्यार के जाल में फंसा लो। [This is the chance, Shekhar. Trap Ayesha in your web of love.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): मेरे दिल में तो प्यार है। तुम्हारे दिल में क्या है आयशा? बोलो। [There is love in my heart. What is in yours, Ayesha? Speak.]
Speaker C (Ayesha): I want you. But I don't need you.
Speaker C (Ayesha): मैं जानती हूं मेरे अब्बू बुरे इंसान हैं। लेकिन मैं उनके जैसी बिल्कुल भी नहीं हूं। मैं तो खुद इस दुनिया से कहीं बहुत दूर चली जाना चाहती हूं। [I know my father is a bad man. But I am nothing like him. I want to go far away from this world myself.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): आयशा, मैं जानता हूं। और मैं तुमसे वादा करता हूं कि मैं खुद तुम्हें यहां से लेकर जाऊंगा। I promise. [Ayesha, I know. And I promise you that I will personally take you away from here. I promise.]
Speaker C (Ayesha): तुम इंग्लिश टीचर नहीं हो ना? शेखर, सच बताओ तुम क्या छुपा रहे हो मुझसे? कौन हो तुम शेखर? [You are not an English teacher, are you? Shekhar, tell the truth, what are you hiding from me? Who are you, Shekhar?]
Speaker B (Shekhar): वक्त आने पर मैं तुम्हें सब बता दूंगा। [When the time comes, I will tell you everything.]
Speaker A (Voiceover): एक डॉन की बेटी ने एक इंग्लिश टीचर से प्यार किया। लेकिन उस टीचर का असली सच कुछ और था। क्या यह प्यार उस सच को झेल पाएगा? आ जाओ इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप पर और सर्च करो 'जासूस टीचर' और एक ऐसी कहानी देखो जिसे छोड़ नहीं पाओगे। और साथ ही साथ आयशा की तरह इंग्लिश भी सीखते जाओगे। ड्रामा भी, लर्निंग भी, दोनों एक ही ऐप में। सिर्फ ₹1 में ट्रायल शुरू करो आज ही। [A don't daughter loved an English teacher. But his real truth was something else. Will this love survive that truth? Come to the English Seekho app, search 'Jasoos Teacher', and watch an unforgettable story. Learn English along the way. Drama and learning in one app. Start your trial for just ₹1 today.]
Speaker E (Voiceover 2): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text:
JASOOS TEACHER
English Seekho
Rajkumari ko bachane [To save the princess]
Mera man hua toh aa gayi. [I felt like coming, so I came.]
Ayesha ji, yeh phool aapke liye [Ayesha, this flower is for you]
Aaj suraj kahan se ug gaya? [Where did the sun rise from today?]
Tum yahan mujhse pehle aa gayi. [You got here before me.]
Toh aaj hum kuchh naya sikhenge. [So today we will learn something new.]
Toh tumhare dil mein mere liye kya hai? [So what is in your heart for me?]
Himmat ya pyar? [Courage or love?]
Yahi mauka hai, Shekhar. [This is the chance, Shekhar.]
Ayesha ko apne pyar ke jaal mein fasa lo. [Trap Ayesha in your web of love.]
Mere dil mein toh pyar hai. [There is love in my heart.]
Tumhare dil mein kya hai, Ayesha? [What is in your heart, Ayesha?]
Bolo. [Speak.]
I want you. But I don't need you.
Main jaanti hoon mere abbu bure insaan hai. [I know my father is a bad man.]
Lekin main unke jaisi bilkul bhi nahin hoon. [But I am nothing like him.]
Main toh khud is duniya se kahin bahut dur chali jana chahti hoon. [I want to go far away from this world myself.]
Ayesha, main jaanta hoon. [Ayesha, I know.]
Aur main tumse wada karta hoon. [And I promise you.]
Ki main khud tumhe yahan se le kar jaunga. [That I will personally take you away from here.]
I promise.
Tum English teacher nahin ho na. [You are not an English teacher, are you.]
Shekhar, sach batao tum kya chupa rahe ho mujhse. [Shekhar, tell the truth, what are you hiding from me.]
Kaun ho tum, Shekhar. [Who are you, Shekhar.]
Waqt aane par main tumhe sab bata dunga. [When the time comes, I will tell you everything.]
Ayesha, Don Sebastian se maafi maango. [Ayesha, apologize to Don Sebastian.]
Abbu, aapko sharam aani chahiye. [Father, you should be ashamed.]
But first I have to make a deal.
INSTALL NOW
summary: The ad promotes the 'English Seekho' app by showcasing a dramatic romantic-thriller series called 'Jasoos Teacher' available on the platform. It hooks viewers with a story about a don't daughter falling for an undercover English teacher. The CTA encourages users to download the app to watch the drama and learn English simultaneously, offering a trial for just 1 rupee.
